claim_ceiling: Four metric learning/hybrid representations (linear_metric_epoch4, mahalanobis_metric_epoch4, hybrid_stabilized_epoch1, hybrid_v2_epoch3) beat production baseline center_projected_64dim on jurist pairwise preference (+0.087 to +0.173) and pass both adversarial gates (language dominance <0.85, jurist pairwise >0.5) on the 1,200-decision development slice. All four pass cross-language retrieval (>0.2) and achieve strong Jurivoc Level 0 NMI (>0.63). Boilerplate resistance is systematically negative for ALL representations (-0.89 to -0.92). Generalization to full 192k corpus unvalidated.
evidence_summary: Frozen evaluation harness v3 (config_hash=4323f833fa72366a, seed=42, factory direction v6) executed on 1,200-decision slice. Config hash verified. Raw results (evaluation_v3_results.json) match state summary exactly across all 6 representations × 10 key metrics. Two critical adversarial gates (language dominance, jurist pairwise) are independent of metric learning training objectives. Reference baseline center_projected_64dim passes both gates (LD=0.7664, JP=0.5121). center_projected_768 fails jurist pairwise (JP=0.4912), confirming prior product finding. Four new representations from legal-distance v6 all pass both gates and beat reference on jurist preference. Boilerplate resistance fails for all (systematic limitation, honestly reported). Scale stability good (~70-72%). Signal ablation v4/v5 hybrids confirmed failing adversarial gates. Evidence tier REPRODUCED correctly applied (development-slice reproduction, not held-out validation). Negative results preserved as first-class evidence. No p-hacking, threshold adjustment, or selective reporting detected.
